## Google ADK Enterprise Observability — OpenTelemetry GenAI Metrics (Dynatrace Grail)
Visualizes all **7 native ADK OpenTelemetry GenAI Histogram Metrics** (`gen_ai.client.token.usage`, `gen_ai.client.operation.duration`, `gen_ai.execute_tool.duration`, `gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration`, `gen_ai.invoke_agent.inference_calls`, `gen_ai.invoke_agent.tool_calls`, `gen_ai.invoke_workflow.duration`) exported via `/api/v2/otlp/v1/metrics` using credentials fetched at runtime from **Google Cloud Secret Manager**.

1.title: 1. GenAI Token Usage by Token Type & Model (gen_ai.client.token.usage)

2.title: 2. GenAI LLM Operation Duration (gen_ai.client.operation.duration)
2.query: timeseries { avg_latency = avg(gen_ai.client.operation.duration), max_latency = max(gen_ai.client.operation.duration) }, by: { `gen_ai.request.model` }

3.title: 3. ADK Tool Execution Duration by Tool (gen_ai.execute_tool.duration)

4.title: 4. ADK Agent Invocation Duration (gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration)
4.query: timeseries { avg_agent_dur = avg(gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration), max_agent_dur = max(gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration) }, by: { `gen_ai.agent.name` }

5.title: 5 & 6. ADK Inference Calls & Tool Calls per Turn (gen_ai.invoke_agent.*_calls)
5.query: timeseries { inference_calls = sum(gen_ai.invoke_agent.inference_calls), tool_calls = sum(gen_ai.invoke_agent.tool_calls) }, by: { `gen_ai.agent.name` }

6.title: 7. ADK Workflow Invocation Duration (gen_ai.invoke_workflow.duration)
6.query: timeseries { avg_workflow_dur = avg(gen_ai.invoke_workflow.duration), max_workflow_dur = max(gen_ai.invoke_workflow.duration) }, by: { `gen_ai.workflow.name` }
